holdout_policy: No outcome or trajectory at or after holdout_start may be read until the full calibration gate passes and a final candidate is frozen.
predecessor_result: v6 pooled temperature RMSE was 2.049 C and four compartments failed; errors were concentrated at night and while lights were off.
candidate: Reuse the frozen v5 physical parameters, v1 floor-normalized lighting, and v6 boundary initialization without refitting.

fixed_pipe_state_correction.active_replay: Observed positive process pipe temperatures continue to determine all active heat exchange.
fixed_pipe_state_correction.internal_tracking: For state continuity, bounded boiler input equals the observed-temperature heat-loss demand plus the existing proportional correction.
fixed_pipe_state_correction.off_intervals: Boiler input remains zero and replay uses the propagated internal pipe state.
fixed_pipe_state_correction.selection: No coefficient is selected from climate outcomes; existing 300 s tracking constants and published capacity limits remain fixed.

calibration_check: Run the same 21 pre-holdout sequences and apply the frozen gate pooled and to every compartment.
outcome_rule: If the full calibration gate fails, do not access holdout and do not tune the feed-forward term.
